summary: 17 errors, 33 minor across 26 units; units without issues: 2, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11, 25, 26, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 38. No regrouping suggested (edition grouping is sensible). Main patterns: glossary breaks (mati, kratu, ṛta), additions in Hindi (सब, घोड़े, जोश में, वायु, extra svāhā), unit 12 mirrored repetition misread, unit 23 purohitāḥ, unit 34 invented split, unit 37 yajñavāhasi locative, wrong voice label on avajighrata (units 9, 19). Suggested glossary additions: netra = 'having X as leader'; purohita = purohita; samana = contest; stoma and upayāma untranslated; ṷ/ḙ are accent marks (never typo flags).
